user_story: As a user, I want to set a priority level on a task so that I know what to work on first.

positive.title: Set a high priority on a task
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Select a task from the list.
Choose 'High' from the priority level dropdown.
positive.expected_result: The task priority is updated to 'High' and displayed correctly in the task list.

negative.title: Attempt to set an invalid priority level on a task
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Select a task from the list.
Enter 'Urgent' (an invalid priority) in the priority level input.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that 'Urgent' is not a valid priority level.

edge.title: Set priority on the maximum number of tasks allowed (bulk update)
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Select the maximum number of tasks allowed (e.g., 100 tasks).
Choose 'Medium' from the priority level dropdown for all selected tasks.
edge.expected_result: All selected tasks' priorities are updated to 'Medium' without any errors.
